blocks.text: Successful businesses understand customers' needs. A water-purifier seller in Karachi might stress clean drinking water during hot summers. A Lahore start-up selling handmade jewellery online shows products on Instagram and Facebook, works with local influencers and offers limited-time wedding-season discounts to grow sales. E-commerce in Pakistan is growing fast, so businesses that market well online reach a much wider audience.
